key_insight: LLM-highlighted evidence does not always align with prediction behavior, and consistency varies across model families and intervention types.
engineering_relevance: Test model-generated explanations with targeted input interventions before relying on them for classification audits or decision support.
method: Ask models to classify reviews and highlight decisive tokens.
Isolate, remove, or semantically invert highlighted tokens.
Evaluate functional auto-consistency using sufficiency, comprehensiveness, and counterfactuality.
evidence_signal: On IMDB and Steam reviews, GPT-4o-mini followed expected patterns across all metrics; Gemma3 and Granite8B preserved sufficiency but weakened under harder interventions, while DeepSeek variants showed structural deviations.
watch_item: The abstract reports qualitative patterns without numerical effect sizes, leaving the magnitude of model differences unclear.
paper_title: Do Language Models Trust Their Own Justifications? A Study on Functional Consistency
